summaries.name: GreenSpace
summaries.summary: GreenSpace is a rooftop garden event venue offering a peaceful atmosphere. It provides outdoor games including Giant Chess and Croquet, accommodates groups of up to 10 people, and offers a menu of healthy snacks and drinks.

summaries.name: Peerspace
summaries.summary: Peerspace is a platform that allows users to rent unique event spaces, including rooftop venues.

summaries.name: Eventbrite
summaries.summary: Eventbrite is a platform that allows users to find and book event spaces, including rooftop venues.

summaries.name: Rooftop Republic
summaries.summary: Rooftop Republic is a rooftop event space rental company that offers a range of rooftop venue options in the city.
